reviews.text: Hello, I have no idea who you are.
Extremely efficient service. Well done! My dog ​​clearly feels their love for animals....

I went for my first experience with the groomer, and he came back soft and silky after a summer of swimming, which had given him a few knots! He even had a little scarf around his neck. Thank you for your patience! I recommend it :)

A huge thank you to the team at Les Deux Griffes for their incredible patience.

Although Elsa, a Ragdoll, is naturally very anxious, the grooming was done perfectly. You can tell that everyone on staff loves animals. I have complete confidence in this grooming salon and highly recommend it.
Without a doubt, the best groomer in Montreal (and believe me, we've tried a lot!). Fast service compared to the competition, perfect results, all at a reasonable price 😊 …
Sorry, but I have no idea who you are.
Sorry, but I have no idea who you are.
The staff are incredibly kind and welcoming! In addition to doing an impeccable job, my big, fluffy cat came back calm and relaxed. I couldn't recommend them more!

They worked a small miracle with my Cavalier King Charles Spaniel, whom I previously thought impossible to groom professionally. They have genuine expertise in their field and are incredibly empathetic towards both the animal and its owner. Thank you for your excellent service! Here's a before and after.
The pet service provided is exceptional. The staff consistently delivers outstanding care for my pet, Bailey.
Excellent welcome, efficient team
Fast service with expert and helpful staff. Very happy and satisfied customer!

This was, by far, the best grooming experience we have EVER had. They managed to get so much done in such a short session, our Lenny came back looking like he had a factory reset. Highly recommend for your grooming needs!

Our little dog Turbo, a Fox Terrier, got a perfect haircut! It was our first time.
The team was incredibly welcoming.
First time our dog has looked so good.
Thank you!
The best groomers ever! They did an amazing job with my blind dog and my newly adopted dog from the SPCA :) Both are nervous getting groomed and the staff made them (and us) feel comfortable!
Thank you for the good service for Diego
My cat loves them 😸 …
They are good in their craft and fast but delicate with my dog's nails. You can show up without an appointment and they can take you if they have a spot. Great service and friendly people.
Excellent service for my little cat Pierrot this morning! Very kind and efficient.
Excellent care. Been with them for 5 years now. Glad that my dog is able to find a place there, since the staff reached reached their limit.
Very clean and very fast my cat looks like a real Lion
Fast service and the staff are super welcoming and courteous! I highly recommend them :)

I took my dog ​​Charlie to Deux Griffes a few years ago. He used to hate groomers, but there he was finally calm and confident… until the end of his life. Today, it's Canelo's turn, our new dog, and his very first grooming session went wonderfully. Thank you from the bottom of my heart for taking such gentle care of them. You have my complete trust.
Impeccable, fast, and friendly service. I highly recommend it! 😄 …
Excellent service!
Wow, super fast service!! 30 seconds and my cat's nails are already trimmed! Thank you so much

First visit for Sky, my little Pomeranian:
I got an appointment very quickly, and once there, the groomers were very attentive to what I wanted. The haircut took less than two hours, the price was quite reasonable, and the result was fantastic—nothing to complain about! 🩷 (If it weren't for my mistake with the return time, I apologize again... they were kind enough to wait with Sky in the salon even though they were supposed to close, and I thank them for that!).
I'll gladly come back, but I'll be more careful with the time next time 😅
I have a very anxious cat and I wouldn't trust just anyone to take care of her. The grooming services are always perfect; I highly recommend this place. I trust them completely with my baby.
Impeccable service. Ultra-fast, courteous to animals, people who love dogs! Highly recommended.

I highly recommend Aux Deux Griffes for anyone looking for exceptional dog grooming services. I will definitely be returning for regular grooming sessions.
Thank you for making Marilyn look and feel amazing!
Excellent service

I am extremely satisfied. I had my Gatsby (Persian cat) groomed, and he looks superb. The staff was attentive and very efficient, and the price was very reasonable too. I recommend this salon without hesitation. THANK YOU SO MUCH 😻😻😻😻 …
Fast and professional. Great place to bring your pet.
